## Vacation Rental PMS + QuickBooks: What Should Live Where?
The PMS runs the stay. Accounting software runs the books. A clean stack defines which system owns reservations, operating expenses, financial exports and accounting records.
Short answer: A vacation rental PMS and QuickBooks handle different layers — the PMS runs reservations, turnovers and operational expenses; QuickBooks handles accounting, reconciliation and tax reporting. The goal is a clean data handoff between them, not replacing one with the other.

### PMS responsibilities
The PMS can hold operational data such as reservations, property activity, cleaning costs, operating expenses and performance metrics.

### Accounting responsibilities
QuickBooks is an accounting platform. Your accounting setup, chart of accounts, reconciliation and tax workflows should be designed with the appropriate accounting expertise.

### Questions to ask before connecting the systems
Is a current direct integration supported?
What data can be exported or synchronized?
How are properties or units mapped?
How are cleaning and other operating expenses represented?
Which system is the source of truth for financial records?

### Avoid duplicate accounting logic
The goal is not to make the PMS become the accounting system. It is to reduce manual re-entry and ensure the operating data needed by finance can move through a defined workflow.

### Avrenor note
Avrenor includes expense and performance visibility inside its operations product. This page does not claim a current QuickBooks integration. Confirm supported accounting integrations and export options directly with Avrenor.

### Frequently asked questions
Integration methods vary: some PMS platforms offer direct QuickBooks sync, others provide structured CSV/Excel exports for manual import, and some connect through third-party middleware. Confirm the exact integration type, data mapping and synchronization behavior with each vendor before designing the stack.
No. A PMS runs the stay — reservations, turnovers, expenses, operational reporting. QuickBooks runs the books — reconciliation, accounts, tax, statutory reporting. The goal is a clean data handoff from the PMS to the accounting system, not replacing one with the other.

## Vacation Rental PMS + Smart Locks | Integration Guide
URL: https://vacationrentalpms.com/vacation-rental-pms-smart-locks/

INTEGRATIONS

## Vacation Rental PMS + Smart Locks
Smart-lock value comes from connecting access to the correct property, reservation and stay window while keeping exceptions visible to the operations team.
Short answer: A vacation rental PMS smart lock integration automatically creates and expires access codes tied to each reservation's check-in and checkout times — so guests receive unique codes without manual key management and the operations team has visibility into access status.

### What to verify
Supported lock brands and connection method
Code creation and expiration behavior
Reservation and property mapping
Failure and exception handling
Team visibility into access status

### Do not assume compatibility
Smart-lock support varies by PMS, lock provider and integration. Confirm current compatibility directly before buying hardware or changing software.

### Design for exceptions
Automation is useful only if staff can quickly identify failed codes, changed stays or properties requiring manual intervention.

### Frequently asked questions
PMS smart lock integration generates and manages access codes tied to specific reservations and stay windows. When a booking is confirmed, the system creates a code that activates on check-in and expires on checkout, with visibility for the operations team on access status.
Support varies significantly by PMS platform. Common brands include Yale, Schlage, Kwikset, August, Igloohome and others. Always confirm current supported lock brands and connection methods directly with the PMS vendor before purchasing hardware.
Verify: supported lock brands and connection method, how codes are created and when they expire, how property and unit mapping works, how failed codes and exceptions surface to operations staff, and what happens when a reservation is modified or cancelled.
A good PMS + smart lock integration makes failures visible to operations staff immediately, with enough detail to resolve the issue before the guest arrives. Evaluate exception handling and staff alerting before deploying smart locks across a portfolio.
